name: Kuraugi Shion
source:
A first-class investigator with ADONIS' Cybercrime Division 1, working on the front lines to combat serious cybersecurity incidents brought about by the spread of "Plant."
Although he's quiet, uncooperative, and often acts on his own, he boasts a top-class case-solving rate.
However, after becoming embroiled in an incident involving a mysterious piece of hardware called "Cheat Plant," he is demoted to "OCTA," a dead-end position.
